newsitem.title: USA: CCA Prison Realty files for IPO of 17 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: CCA Prison Realty files for IPO of 17 mln shares.

text.p: CCA Prison Realty Trust said Thursday it had filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission for an initial public offering of 17 million shares.
The company said it plans to use the proceeds to buy nine correctional and detention facilities from Corrections Corp of America, and for working capital and general corporate purposes.
It said J.C. Bradford & Co, Legg Mason Wood Walker Inc, Lehman Brothers Inc, PaineWebber Inc and Stephens Inc will manage the offering.
CCA said it will grant the underwriters an option to buy up to 2.55 million additional shares to cover over-allotments.
It said it plans to apply for listing of the shares on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol "PZN" PZN.N.
It said it expects to consummate the offering in late June.
CCA is a Maryland real estate investment trust that buys correctional and detention facilities from private prison managers and government entities.
